# Apache HTTPD (HTTP) — root-context-push-url-sse

root-context-sse with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push. Unlike the WebSocket sibling the relocated endpoint needs no proxy rule of its own: over SSE the catch-all already carries it, so the config is identical to root-context-sse.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# SSE-only proxy with the PUSH endpoint relocated to /VAADIN/push.
#
# Compare with root-context-push-url: over WebSocket the relocated endpoint
# needs its own <Location> block, because it has to be upgraded. Over SSE it
# needs nothing — EventSource is an ordinary GET and the client-to-server
# messages are XHR POSTs, so wherever the push URL is moved to, the catch-all
# already carries it. This file is byte-identical to root-context-sse, and that
# is the point.
<Location />
    ProxyPass         http://vaadin:8080/
    ProxyPassReverse  http://vaadin:8080/
</Location>
```
